'''Nutripaste''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that was kept by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], in the [[Horizon-class star yacht|''Horizon''-class Star Yacht]] ''[[Jade Shadow]]''<nowiki></nowiki>'s stores during their quest to uncover more information about [[Darth Caedus]]' fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].
